question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
Dealing with things in a practical and sensible way
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pragmatic"** means dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations. (व्यावहारिक)
 
 
• **Example: **His pragmatic approach to problem-solving has always been effective.
 
 

 
• **"Pragmatic" **refers to being practical and focused on reaching a goal. (व्यावहारिक)
 
 
• **Example: **She took a pragmatic stance on the issue, favoring practical solutions over theoretical debates.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sceptic **(संशयवादी): A person inclined to question or doubt accepted opinions.
 
 
• **Example:** As a sceptic, he doubted the authenticity of the news.
 
 

 
• **Stoic **(सहिष्णु): A person who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining.
 
 
• **Example: **Even during tough times, she remained stoic and composed.
 
 

 
• **Cynic** (निंदक): A person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honorable or unselfish reasons.
 
 
• **Example:** His cynical view of the world made it difficult for him to trust others.
